name: PET Deface
summary: Defaces a PET image and its T1-weighted anatomical image with petdeface, a Nipype pipeline that co-registers the two and applies FreeSurfer MiDeFace.
description: Wraps the openneuropet petdeface tool, which builds a temporary BIDS dataset from the PET and T1w files, co-registers them and removes facial features from both. Use it to anonymise PET data before sharing. Requires a FreeSurfer license. The current main script expects --t1_file and --pet_file command-line arguments and does not read config.json, so the App may not run as registered.

inputs.description: PET image with its JSON sidecar (blood data optional).
T1-weighted image of the same subject, used for registration and defacing.

parameters.description: PET BIDS Input Directory, must contain both PET and T1w images for each subject.
Defaults to using the derivatives folder in the input directory as a working dir. If used with the "placement" argument
Number of processors/threads to use in the defacing pipeline.
Pipeline will normally fail if dataset is not BIDS valid, setting this to true can help "push" through an almost compliant BIDS dataset.
List of subject ID's to selectively deface.

failure_modes.message: FREESURFER_LICENSE environment variable not set, exiting.
